name: Stanford Health Care Clinical Ethics Consultation Service

record.organization: Stanford Health Care Clinical Ethics Consultation Service
record.purpose: Patient or family may request ethical consultation concerning current patient care decisions.
record.limitations: Internal consult, not disciplinary investigation or a substitute for Patient Relations or independent regulators.

sources.source_title: Published official institutional contact and role evidence
sources.role: Administrative liaison, Stanford Health Care Ethics Committee
sources.stated_purpose: Administrative routing inquiries only; retain pager-based bedside consultation and secure patient-relations channels.
sources.limitations: Official medical staff committee page publishes this liaison address under Ethics. The bedside consultation page still designates the pager as the consultation request route. The liaison is not a clinician or an independent investigator; no claim that ordinary email initiates a clinical consultation. Confirm current role, address and applicable remit before use. Preserve designated intake routes; do not transmit confidential records through ordinary email. Deliverability not tested.
